Learn how to connect TranscriptAPIâs YouTube Transcript MCP to ChatGPT and fetch YouTube video transcripts directly in your conversations. This step-by-step guide walks you through enabling Developer Mode, adding the connector, and using it effectively.
   

Before getting started, ensure you have:

A ChatGPT Plus or Team subscription (required for Developer Mode)
A TranscriptAPI account (sign up free)
10 minutes to complete the setup

ChatGPT Developer Mode BETAChatGPTâs Developer Mode is currently in beta. You may encounter occasional issues like:
Tool calls that appear to fail but actually succeed
Connection errors that require refreshing the connector
Parallel searches that override MCP responses
These are known ChatGPT beta issues. If you experience problems, try the troubleshooting steps in this guide or consider using Claude for a more stable experience.

First, youâll need to enable Developer Mode in ChatGPT to access MCP connectors.

Open ChatGPT and access your profile
Navigate to ChatGPT and click on your profile icon in the bottom left corner of the screen.

Open Settings
From the profile menu, click on âSettingsâ to access your account preferences.

Navigate to Apps & Connectors
In the settings panel, click on âApps & Connectorsâ to access the connector configuration.

Scroll to Advanced settings
Scroll down in the Apps & Connectors section to find additional options.

Access Advanced settings
Click on âAdvanced settingsâ to reveal developer options.

Enable Developer Mode
Toggle the âDeveloper modeâ switch to enable MCP connector support. This allows you to add custom connectors like TranscriptAPI.

Return to Apps & Connectors
Click âBackâ to return to the main Apps & Connectors page where youâll add the TranscriptAPI connector.

Now that Developer Mode is enabled, you can add the TranscriptAPI MCP connector.

Create a new connector
Click on âCreateâ to start adding a new connector.

Select New Connector
Choose âNew Connectorâ¦â from the dropdown menu.

Get TranscriptAPI configuration
Open TranscriptAPI MCP Integration page in a new tab. Youâll need to copy configuration details from here.

Upload the connector icon
Back in ChatGPT, click the icon selector and upload the TranscriptAPI logo you downloaded.

Copy and paste the MCP name
From the TranscriptAPI dashboard, copy the MCP name (usually âTranscript APIâ).

Paste it into the âNameâ field in ChatGPT.

Copy and paste the description
Copy the MCP description from TranscriptAPI.

Paste it into the âDescriptionâ field in ChatGPT.

Copy and paste the server URL
This is the most important step. Copy the MCP Server URL from TranscriptAPI (it should be https://transcriptapi.com/mcp).

Paste it into the server URL field in ChatGPT.

Get your OAuth credentials
ChatGPT requires Client ID and Client Secret for OAuth authentication. On the TranscriptAPI MCP Integration page, make sure âOAuth (Recommended)â is selected in the Authentication Method dropdown.
If you donât have credentials yet, click âGenerate Credentialsâ to create your Client ID and Client Secret.
Copy both the Client ID and Client Secret from the TranscriptAPI dashboard. Youâll need these in the next step.
Save Your CredentialsThe Client Secret is only shown once when first generated or regenerated. Make sure to copy it immediately and store it securely. If you lose it, you can regenerate a new secret, but the old one will stop working.

Add Client ID and Client Secret to ChatGPT
Back in ChatGPT, paste your Client ID into the Client ID field and your Client Secret into the Client Secret field.

Acknowledge the terms
Check the box that says âI understand and want to continueâ¦â to acknowledge that youâre connecting to an external service.

Create the connector
Click âCreateâ to add the TranscriptAPI connector to your ChatGPT account.

OAuth FlowWith Client ID and Client Secret configured, ChatGPT will handle the OAuth authorization flow automatically. You may still be redirected to TranscriptAPI to authorize access, but the credentials you provided ensure ChatGPT can complete the authentication process.
After creating the connector, youâll need to authorize it to access your TranscriptAPI account.

TranscriptAPI authorization page
Youâll be redirected to TranscriptAPIâs authorization page. If youâre not already logged in, youâll need to sign in first.

Review permissions
Check the box to acknowledge that ChatGPT will be able to use your API credits and access the MCP server.

Complete authorization
Click âAuthorizeâ to grant ChatGPT access to TranscriptAPI through OAuth.

Connection successful
Youâll see a success message confirming that TranscriptAPI is now connected to your ChatGPT account.

Now youâre ready to fetch YouTube transcripts directly in ChatGPT!

Access the MCP tool
In a new ChatGPT conversation, click the âAdd files and moreâ button (paperclip icon).

Open more options
Click âMoreâ to see additional tool options.

Select TranscriptAPI
Click on âTranscriptAPIâ from the list of available tools.

Start a new conversation
Youâll see the TranscriptAPI tool is now active in your conversation. The interface may show âChatGPT 5â or similar version indicator.

Request a transcript
Paste a prompt like: âFetch transcript and summarize this long video for me https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_IDâ

Send your request
Click the send button to submit your transcript request.

Confirm tool usage
ChatGPT will ask you to confirm the use of the TranscriptAPI tool. Click âConfirmâ to proceed.

Success! Transcript fetched
The MCP will successfully fetch the YouTube transcript, and ChatGPT will process it according to your request (summarize, analyze, translate, etc.).

Here are some effective ways to use TranscriptAPI in ChatGPT:

Fetch the transcript and summarize this TED talk for me:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UF8uR6Z6KLc

Get the transcript from this video and translate it to Spanish:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UF8uR6Z6KLc

Search YouTube for "quantum computing explained" andtell me what the top results cover.

Show me the latest videos from @natgeo and summarize

Search @TED for videos about education. List what you find.

List the videos in this playlist:https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOGi5-fAu8bFIs_Lbp-MNwPKpPjBJGUzrGet the transcript for the first video and create study notes.

Symptom: ChatGPT says it couldnât fetch the transcript, but if you ask again, it has the content.
Solution: This happens when ChatGPT runs a parallel search that overrides the MCP response. Simply ask ChatGPT to use the transcript it already fetched.

Symptom: Random errors about the MCP tool being unavailable.
Solution:

Go back to Apps & Connectors in settings
Click on the TranscriptAPI connector
Select âRefresh toolsâ or âReauthorizeâ
Try your request again

Symptom: The tool takes a long time or times out.
Solution:

For very long videos (>2 hours), the transcript fetch may take longer
Try again with a shorter video first to test the connection
Check your TranscriptAPI credit balance

Symptom: Error message about payment required or no credits.
Solution: Purchase more credits in your TranscriptAPI dashboard.

Symptom: 404 error or âtranscript not availableâ message.
Solution: The video may:

Not have captions enabled
Be private or age-restricted
Be deleted or unavailable in your region

If you continue experiencing issues:

For ChatGPT beta issues: Consider using Claude for a more stable MCP experience
For TranscriptAPI issues: Contact support with your specific error message
For general MCP questions: See our MCP documentation
